Authored human animations — Mesh2Motion contributors
File: motions/companion-motion.json
Source clips: Walk, Walk_Carry, Idle_A from human-base-animations.glb
Source: https://github.com/Mesh2Motion/mesh2motion-app/tree/main/static/animations
Official asset license: CC0 1.0 Universal
https://github.com/Mesh2Motion/mesh2motion-app/blob/main/LICENSE-CC0.MD
https://github.com/Mesh2Motion/mesh2motion-app#licenses
License legal text: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode
The compact local data contains normalized humanoid bone rotations only;
source mesh, textures, scales, and root translations are not included.
See motions/README.md for provenance, extraction, and coordinate details.
The animation license does not change the separate avatar model licenses above.

Motion implementation combines these authored upper-body walking, carrying,
and idle clips with Footwork leg IK and procedural keyframed gestures.

Studio room and folder prop
studio-room.png and studio-folder.png were generated for this prototype on
2026-09-22. The room is a fixed-camera image derived from the selected studio
concept; the avatar is rendered separately. Generation briefs are recorded in
asset-research/studio-room-clean.md and asset-research/studio-folder.md.
